about-strip.heading: Our story
How we got here
About the kitchen
about-strip.body: We started with one oven and a stubborn sourdough starter. Ten years later the starter is still going and so are we.
A small kitchen, a short menu and suppliers we actually know. Nothing arrives frozen and nothing sits under a lamp.
We cook the food we want to eat on a day off, and we serve it the way we would want it served.
